description: Comment edit: the new PUT /articles/:slug/comments/:id handler never checks that the caller wrote the comment, so any signed-in user can rewrite anyone's comment.
notes: FM-13 (authorization and trust boundaries). ArticleCommentUpdate loads the comment by id and article, binds the body and saves it, but never compares commentModel.AuthorID with the caller's ArticleUserModel (as ArticleCommentDelete does). Any authenticated user can rewrite any comment, an open exploit the ticket explicitly forbids. Severity critical: FM-13 and Argus grade an exploitable missing server-side check as critical. Fix: after FindOneComment, `if commentModel.AuthorID != GetArticleUserModel(myUserModel).ID` return 403, as in ArticleCommentDelete. The route, the UpdateBody model method and the 404/422 paths are legitimate.
